ops: /* Phone widths: keep the top bar on one line inside the screen */
#main-header-title { max-width: 40vw; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 1rem; }
/* Open menu slides over the page instead of squeezing it; closed menu stays as an icon rail */
#app-sidebar.w-64 { position: fixed; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; z-index: 60; box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35) !important; }
